userNote: Makers Market - People's History Museum Saturday/sunday
tip: Come Sat/Sun 11:00-16:30 (free, donations welcome); Café Gather is open all weekend. The Friday evening preview costs £10 including a mulled wine.
bookingNote: Sat/Sun free entry (most donate ~£10). Fri 20 Nov preview evening is ticketed (£10).
priceNote: Free Sat/Sun; preview Fri £10; lino printing £20; Spirited Women cocktail tasting £20
hoursNote: Hours are the market hours (Fri preview 17:00-20:00). Normal museum gallery hours not verified.
tripNote: YES, the Winter Makers Market runs this weekend: Fri 20 Nov preview 17:00-20:00 (ticketed), Sat 21 and Sun 22 Nov 11:00-16:30 (free). Hallé Choir Sat, Magic Voices Choir Sun (times not listed).

events.name: Winter Makers Market preview evening (£10, mulled wine, live jazz)

name: Winter Makers Market at People's History Museum
blurb: Indie makers market in the museum's Engine Hall with 30+ stalls of ceramics, jewellery, prints and cards, plus workshops and live choirs.
address: People's History Museum, Left Bank, Spinningfields, Manchester M3 3ER

tip: Visiting groups are not admitted 13:00-14:00 daily (Eucharist); donation of £5 suggested, contactless accepted.
hoursNote: Hours may vary during services and special events; access can be limited to the east end during event set-up.
tripNote: Next to Cathedral Gardens, which hosts a Christmas market site (to 3 Jan 2027) so expect crowds.
name: Manchester Cathedral
blurb: Medieval cathedral with a Victorian-Gothic interior and a quire with rare carved wooden stalls, in the heart of the city.

tip: Open until 21:00 on Thursdays only; Monday closed (so Fri-Sun only for this trip). Gulnur Mukazhanova opens 20 Nov.
hoursNote: Closed Mondays including bank holidays. Cafe 10:00-17:00 Tue-Sun (last food orders 15:30).
tripNote: Gulnur Mukazhanova: The Manifold of Memory opens 20 Nov 2026. Also on: Our Collections, Reimagined; Reflections: Sangat and the Self; The Labour of Care; Hyundai Translocal Series (to 3 Jan). William Morris: Common Paradise opens 5 Dec (after trip). No gallery closures listed for November.
name: The Whitworth
blurb: University of Manchester art gallery in Whitworth Park with textiles, modern art and a cafe, and free entry.
address: The Whitworth, The University of Manchester, Oxford Road, Manchester M15 6ER

tip: Check manchesterartgallery.org on the day: official site blocked automated access and third-party listings disagree on closed day.
hoursNote: UNVERIFIED on official site: Art Fund listing says Tue-Sun 10:00-17:00; another listing says Wed-Sun. Monday assumed closed.
tripNote: Splendours of the Sikh Raj: Arms and Armour runs to 29 Nov 2026; Out of the Crate and Trading Station: How Hot Drinks Shape Our Lives run to 31 Dec 2026 (third-party listings).
name: Manchester Art Gallery
blurb: City-centre municipal gallery with Pre-Raphaelites, contemporary shows and a large free collection.

tip: Open Wed-Sat only, so Friday and Saturday are your options; last entry 16:40.
hoursNote: Official page lists Wed-Sat 10:00-17:00 (last entry 16:40); Sun/Mon implied closed, not stated explicitly.
tripNote: Closed Sunday and Monday of the trip (implied). Exhibition on: Church and State: Emperor Charlemagne's legacy (dates not given).
name: The John Rylands Library
blurb: Neo-Gothic Victorian library on Deansgate with a cathedral-like reading room and rare manuscripts.

tip: Booking free tickets in advance is recommended. Parts are shut for restoration so check gallery list; no on-site parking; nearest Metrolink is Deansgate-Castlefield.
bookingNote: Free entry; booking free timed tickets online is recommended. Special exhibitions may charge.
hoursNote: Daily 10:00-17:00. Cafe 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri, 09:30-17:00 Sat/Sun; bistro from 11:00 at weekends.
tripNote: Several buildings and galleries are CLOSED during a multi-million-pound restoration (Air and Space Hall permanently closed). Open per official page: Power Hall (Andrew Law Gallery), Revolution Manchester, Textiles, Experiment; Power Up gaming at weekends; Horrible Science: Cosmic Chaos runs to 3 Jan 2027 (may be ticketed).
name: Science and Industry Museum
blurb: Museum on the site of the world's oldest passenger railway station, covering the Industrial Revolution and Manchester innovation.

tip: Saturday opens at 08:00 with a Quiet Time until 10:00. Last admission 30 min before closing.
bookingNote: Free; only the Magic Place winter experience needs booking (starts 28 Nov, after the trip)
hoursNote: Closed Mondays. Wed 10:00-21:00. Last admission 30 minutes before close.
tripNote: The Vivarium and Nature's Library are CLOSED until May 2027. Magic Place (winter experience) opens 28 Nov 2026, after the trip.
name: Manchester Museum
blurb: University of Manchester natural history and culture museum with fossils, Stan the T. rex, live animals and a free-entry policy.
address: The University of Manchester, Oxford Road, Manchester M13 9PL

tip: Coordinates point to the Faulkner Street archway. Many restaurants and bakeries around it are good for an evening or dim sum stop.
hoursNote: Open-air district, always accessible; individual shops and restaurants keep their own hours.
name: Manchester Chinatown
blurb: One of the largest Chinatowns in the UK, entered through the ornate Imperial Chinese Archway on Faulkner Street.

tip: Best seen after dark when the Christmas market lights and Ferris wheel are on.
hoursNote: Open-air square; Christmas market stalls and attractions have their own hours (unconfirmed for 2026).
tripNote: Square only partly reopened (reopened 2025 after about six years behind hoarding); Manchester Town Hall restoration still under way (completion reported for 2027), so scaffolding likely. Christmas Markets site with a 50m Ferris wheel, helter-skelter and new pop-up pub, running 6 Nov 2026 to 3 Jan 2027.
name: Albert Square
blurb: Manchester's civic square in front of the Gothic Revival Town Hall, and the centrepiece of the Christmas Markets.

tip: Heaton Park Metrolink stop (Bury line) is on the western edge of the park across a road. Heritage tramway mainly runs in summer, so expect it closed in November.
bookingNote: Free entry, pay-and-display parking not verified
hoursNote: Opens 08:00 daily; all gates are locked at dusk (about 16:00 in late November, estimated, not an official time). Venues inside keep their own hours.
tripNote: Winter trails reported through February; check for event closures.
name: Heaton Park
blurb: One of Europe's largest municipal parks with woodland, a lake, Heaton Hall and an animal centre.
address: Heaton Park, Middleton Road, Manchester M25 2SW

tip: Performance times and prices could not be verified; book on ATG Tickets.
hoursNote: Performance times not verified. Check ATG calendar. Empty hours here do not mean closed.
tripNote: CATS runs Tue 10 to Sat 21 Nov 2026, so Fri 20 and Sat 21 only. Sources disagree (one lists start 18 Nov). No performance times found. Billy Elliot opens 2 Dec. A Palace Theatre Tour runs from 23 Nov.
name: Palace Theatre Manchester
blurb: Grand Oxford Street theatre hosting the touring CATS musical until Sat 21 Nov.

tip: Showtimes taken from ticket listings (ATG pages did not render times); confirm before booking.
priceNote: From about £15 (Christmas Carol Goes Wrong, aggregator listing); Josh Pugh from about £31 inc fees
hoursNote: Hours are performance windows only (Christmas Carol Goes Wrong running time 2h20 incl interval; Sun/Mon end time approximate).
tripNote: Christmas Carol Goes Wrong (Mischief) Tue 17 to Sat 21 Nov. Sun 22 Nov: Josh Pugh (start 19:30 per ticket sites, 19:45 per Chortle). Mon 23 Nov: An Evening with Sir Chris Hoy 19:30. Dick Whittington panto listed from 17 Nov by one source only, unconfirmed.

events.name: Josh Pugh: Ha Ha, Yeah Sound
An Evening with Sir Chris Hoy

name: Opera House Manchester
blurb: Quay Street theatre with Christmas Carol Goes Wrong (to Sat 21 Nov) then comedy and talks on Sun/Mon.

tip: Book online in advance for cheaper tickets; daytime last entry 15:00. Lanterns & Light is a separate evening slot (16:30-20:00).
bookingNote: Advance booking not mandatory (same-day tickets sold 09:30-14:00) but saves money; Lanterns & Light slots sell out.
priceNote: Day ticket NOT verified for Nov 2026. Visit Chester (Mar 2026) quoted £34 online vs £38 on the day (adult). Lanterns & Light: £12 for slots after 18:30 in November (not Saturdays).
hoursNote: Daytime zoo closes 15:30 on Lanterns & Light dates (normally 16:00); last entry 1 hour before close. Verified on official site 18 Nov.
tripNote: Lanterns & Light runs nightly 13 Nov to 3 Jan; quiet hour 16:00 on 20 and 21 Nov.

travel.transit: train to Chester plus bus, time unverified

name: Chester Zoo
blurb: One of the UK's largest zoos, with the evening Lanterns & Light trail running from 13 Nov 2026 to 3 Jan 2027.
address: Cedar House, Caughall Road, Upton-by-Chester, Chester CH2 1LH

userNote: Altrincham market - 25-45 min drive, 50 public transport
tip: Market House is closed on Mondays, so go Fri-Sun. Metrolink Altrincham stop is a short walk.
hoursNote: From third-party listings (Manchester's Finest etc.): Tue-Sat 09:00-22:00, Sun 09:00-18:00, Mon closed. Official site unreachable. Outdoor market days/hours unverified (one listing: closed Mon and Wed).
tripNote: Closed Mon 23 Nov. Coordinates are Market Street, approximate to the hall.
name: Altrincham Market (Market House)
blurb: Restored Victorian Market House food hall with independent food stalls, a bar and an outdoor market next door.
address: Market House, 1 Market Street, Altrincham WA14 1PD

tip: Other sites: Cathedral Gardens (to 3 Jan), Lincoln Square (new, off Brazennose St), King Street, St Ann's Square, Exchange Street, New Cathedral Street, Exchange Square, Corn Exchange, Market Street. Albert Square is busiest at weekends; go before 17:00.
bookingNote: Free to enter; Ferris wheel and rides are paid
hoursNote: UNCONFIRMED: 2026 hours not published; 10:00-21:00 is the 2025 pattern (craft stalls reportedly closed earlier, about 20:00).
tripNote: Confirmed: markets open Fri 6 Nov to Tue 22 Dec 2026; Albert Square and Cathedral Gardens stay open to Sun 3 Jan 2027 (some sources say 4 Jan). Lincoln Square is new; new pop-up pub in Albert Square. Town Hall restoration continues. So fully running on 20-23 Nov.
name: Manchester Christmas Markets
blurb: Ten city-centre sites with 210+ stalls, centred on Albert Square with a 50m Ferris wheel and helter-skelter.
